cell_type.evidence: Our findings suggest the existence of altered functions of the duodenal epithelium, particularly in response to lipopolysaccharide and viruses.

The duodenal biopsy samples from the CVID patients were subgrouped according to the presence of increased IEL (CVID_IEL), or CVID patients with no inflammation (normal) (CVID_N), as previously described.

disease_state.evidence: A substantial proportion of common variable immunodeficiency (CVID) patients has duodenal inflammation of largely unknown etiology.

DNA, total RNA, and protein were isolated from snap-frozen pieces of duodenal biopsy samples from CVID (with and without duodenal inflammation), healthy controls, and patients with celiac disease (untreated).
